texte.Saisissez le chiffre d’affaires annuel m: Enter the annual worldwide turnover in millions of euros. The “what governs” column says, for your size, whether it is the fixed amount or the percentage — and from what threshold it switches: €# million for the heavy tier, €# million for the other two. An SME that reads “# % of my turnover” hears a figure ten times too low: it is # million that applies to it.
Enter the annual worldwide turnover and read the three tiers.
texte.Saisissez le chiffre d’affaires mondial: Enter the worldwide turnover of the GROUP, not that of the subsidiary concerned: the base is that of the undertaking to which the entity belongs, and reading the subsidiary’s figure divides the exposure by the gap between the two. A useful benchmark: the two tiers pivot at the same turnover, €# million. Below it, the flat-rate floors govern; above it, the percentages. The gap between the two qualifications remains # % on either side.
texte.Sanctions : jusqu à #M€ ou #% du CA mond: Penalties: up to €#M or #% of worldwide turnover (Art. #)
texte.Sanctions par États membres : jusqu'à #: Penalties by Member State: up to €# million or #% of worldwide turnover (Art. #), €# million or #% (high-risk systems), €# million or #% (other infringements). SMEs: proportionality guaranteed. The higher of the two thresholds applies.
texte.Sans ce dossier, aucune évaluation de co: Without this file, no conformity assessment is possible — it is the document on which everything else depends.
texte.Sans liste nominative, la vague # n’aura: Without a list of names, wave # will have no denominator: “share of the team using it” assumes you know which team you are talking about.

texte.Sans suppression nommée, le nouveau proc: Without a named removal, the new process is added to the old one: the time given back measured in wave # will be zero, and rightly so.
texte.Sans systèmes enregistrés, tout se vaut: Without recorded systems, everything is equal and nothing stands out. It is the register that turns a news feed into a to-do list.

texte.Sentinel SITUE et COMPARE des pays. Le c: Sentinel LOCATES and COMPARES countries. The engineering calculation for YOUR site — measured PUE and WUE, embodied carbon, sizing — is not self-service: it is a study, and it has to be commissioned.
texte.Servez-vous en pour répartir avant d’éva: Use it to allocate before assessing. Handing “AI risks according to NIST” to the CISO amounts to making them answer for subjects they do not hold and over which they have no means of action — which produces a risk register that nobody arbitrates.
texte.Seule la facturation au jeton est chiffr: Only per-token billing can be costed by a per-token price table. The others are RECOGNISED and NOT COSTED: it is a declared gap, not a zero.

texte.Si décisionnel sur des personnes : poten: If making decisions about people: potentially high-risk. Otherwise, ISO/IEC # good practice.
texte.Si l'infrastructure est critique (eau, é: If the infrastructure is critical (water, energy, finance, digital): high-risk (Annex III, point #). Otherwise: limited risk, but NIS # applies in parallel.
texte.Si la modification n’affecte pas l’ensem: If the modification does not affect the whole, you only rate the modified part — and you must be able to justify it.
texte.Si la traduction produit du contenu publ: If the translation produces published content: marking, Art. #(#). If the model is GPAI: check that the provider complies with Art. # (documentation, acceptable use policy).
